tables.label: tab:glue_official
tables.caption: GLUE Test results, scored by the evaluation server (https://gluebenchmark.com/leaderboard). The number below each task denotes the number of training examples. The "Average" column is slightly different than the official GLUE score, since we exclude the problematic WNLI set. BERT and OpenAI GPT are single-model, single task. F1 scores are reported for QQP and MRPC, Spearman correlations are reported for STS-B, and accuracy scores are reported for the other tasks. We exclude entries that use BERT as one of their components.

tables.label: tab:task_ablation
tables.caption: Ablation over the pre-training tasks using the BERT_BASEarchitecture. "No NSP" is trained without the next sentence prediction task. "LTR & No NSP" is trained as a left-to-right LM without the next sentence prediction, like OpenAI GPT. "+ BiLSTM" adds a randomly initialized BiLSTM on top of the "LTR + No NSP" model during fine-tuning.
